statement:
How well an LLM helps with statistics depends a
lot on the model and the prompt, so one good result
should not be assumed to hold for other tools.

AI will make p-hacking much worse, because
trying thousands of analyses now takes almost
no effort.

When AI tests many analysis options,
researchers should report all of them, not
just the ones that worked.

Any result where AI helped choose the model
should be labeled exploratory, never
confirmatory.

An AI system that rates depression about as
accurately as a human evaluator is ready to
support real clinical decisions.
